verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Supernova as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki, with projectile, ball, long-range, tracking, 18-hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Expert Mission 6 — The Depths of Despair as the acquisition route. Independent GameFAQs and Steam reports corroborate the Expert Mission 6 route and report that the skill drop is RNG rather than automatic.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because this is an Expert Mission acquisition and no qualifying Ultimate Finish evidence is applicable.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Supernova is kept distinct from Supernova Cooler and DUAL Supernova.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage and hit totals are not promoted as canonical database values because version-specific damage can change; current reference characteristics are retained as mechanics only.

records.skill_description: Create a massive Ki sphere above the user and throw it at the opponent as a long-range tracking Ultimate.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Supernova as a projectile/ball Ultimate with long range, tracking, 18-hit, and knockback characteristics. Independent reports identify Expert Mission 6 against Great Ape Vegeta as the acquisition route and describe the skill drop as RNG rather than an automatic reward. The 500 Ki cost is the canonical standard skill cost; Supernova Cooler is a separate variant.
